# Declaration of Generative AI Use {#sec-ai-declaration}

In accordance with the ZHAW declaration requirement for generative AI, the generative AI systems used in the preparation of this thesis are listed below together with their purpose. Prompts and their corresponding outputs are not declared. A summary narrative of how these systems were used, including their role as a source of inspiration and critical dialogue, is given in the introduction.

## Register of Generative AI Systems

Anthropic. (2026). *Claude* (Opus 4, Cowork). https://claude.ai

- Research and verification of bibliographic references
- Drafting, condensing, and reformulation of text passages
- Structuring of chapters and sections
- Generating R code for the schematic figures in the theory chapter
- Generation and debugging of R and Python code
- Assistance in the creation of the QGIS Plugin

Google. (2026). *Gemini*. https://gemini.google.com

- Literature research and locating relevant sources
- Structuring of chapters and sections
- Generating and reformulating text suggestions
- Explaining and summarising technical concepts
- Generation and debugging of R and Python code

## Scope of Use

All scientific content, data analysis, modelling decisions, and conclusions are the author's own work. Generative AI systems were used as auxiliary tools as listed above and did not replace the author's analytical or interpretive contribution. Every factual claim and every reference that passed through an AI tool was checked by the author against the primary source before inclusion.
